minutes.headline: Sewer Commission approved FY21 year-end encumbrances and commitments and had the chair sign a contractor's bond.
minutes.summary: The commission heard the sewer manager's update on the Hollis/Pond/Kimball sewer extension, the Howard Street 40B site visit, and the end of FY21 finances. It approved encumbrances, year-end commitments, prior minutes, and authorizing the chair to sign a bond, then adjourned.

votes.outcome: passed (roll call; four ayes heard, including the chair)

votes.motion: Have the chairman sign the bond for the contractor's contract

budget_items.what_was_said: Encumbrances cover a contractor's last invoice, clean basins work, the Green Mountain Elizabeth Street work, Leominster debt service, Verizon, generator contract and supplies.
figures_as_heard: sixty thousand seventy one dollars fifty eight cents

budget_items.what_was_said: Expenses came in below revenues, leaving a profit that goes to retained earnings once the year is closed.
The surplus goes into retained earnings when the year is closed out, formally at the state recap in October or November.
A few final readings after fourth quarter billing produced a small commitment needing approval.
The Fitchburg amount is down from the prior month but heavy rain may raise the next one.
The pump station solar is producing credits on electric invoices; a full year is needed to judge the impact.
A bond arrived from the contractor matching the contract's required amount.
The chair wants to discuss grants from the federal infrastructure bill with the manager and Leominster counterpart.

decisions.decision: Chair asked for future agenda items: redo the budget form with the town accountant, a regular maintenance report from the manager, and a grants discussion.
Members asked to attend the Howard Street 40B site visit on July 28 at 1 pm; the town wants confirmation of a representative.
Letters can now go to property owners since the extension will run down Kimball.
Next meetings set for July 27 in person and August 10 by Zoom.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission approved FY21 year-end encumbrances by roll call, with four ayes heard including the chair.
It approved a small set of FY21 year-end commitments after fourth-quarter billing, by roll call.
It voted by roll call to have the chairman sign the bond for the contractor's contract.
The sewer manager reported that letters can now go to property owners because the Hollis/Pond/Kimball extension will run down Kimball.
Next meetings were set for July 27 in person and August 10 by Zoom; members were asked to confirm a representative for the July 28 Howard Street 40B site visit.

why_it_matters: The year-end votes close out FY21 sewer accounts, and the surplus of revenues over expenses goes into retained earnings, which is sewer-fund money rather than general tax money.
Property owners along Kimball may soon receive letters about the sewer extension, and the contractor's bond is the guarantee attached to that work.
watch_next: Meetings on July 27 (in person) and August 10 (Zoom), with a budget form redo, a maintenance report and a grants discussion requested for the agenda.
The Howard Street 40B site visit on July 28 at 1 pm, and the state recap in October or November where retained earnings are formally closed.
